71427-two-young-lumbermen.title: Two Young Lumbermen
71427-two-young-lumbermen.creator: Unknown
71427-two-young-lumbermen.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ULMER BALASCO SHOWS HIS HAND   XXXI. AN UNEXPECTED APPOINTMENT   XXXIII. THE RAILROAD CONTRACT   XXXIV. DALE COMES INTO HIS OWN   XXXV. END OF THE CONTRACT AND OF THE STORY   ILLUSTRATIONS  "Want a job, eh?"  It leaped forward with lowered antlers directly for the young lumberman. "A bear!" cried Dale. Logs rose and fell in front and on each side of them. "Have ye got 'em?" he demanded, in a shrill voice. it's down!" cried Dale. Ulmer Balasco shook his fist in the young lumberman's face.

arxiv-1811-11709.title: High-dimensional Log-Error-in-Variable Regression with Applications to Microbial Compositional Data Analysis
arxiv-1811-11709.creator: Yuchen Zhou, Anru R. Zhang
arxiv-1811-11709.description: Abstract In microbiome and genomic studies, the regression of compositional data has been a crucial tool for identifying microbial taxa or genes that are associated with clinical phenotypes. To account for the variation in sequencing depth, the classic log-contrast model is often used where read counts are normalized into compositions.

arxiv-2208-07840.title: Multi-Pair D2D Communications Aided by An Active RIS over Spatially Correlated Channels with Phase Noise
arxiv-2208-07840.creator: Zhangjie Peng, Xue Liu, Cunhua Pan, Li Li, Jiangzhou Wang
arxiv-2208-07840.description: Abstract This paper investigates a multi-pair device-to-device (D2D) communication system aided by an active reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) with phase noise and direct link. The approximate closed-form expression of the ergodic sum rate is derived over spatially correlated Rician fading channels with statistical channel state information (CSI).

arxiv-2302-00998.title: Convergence condition of simulated quantum annealing with a non-stoquastic catalyst
arxiv-2302-00998.creator: Yusuke Kimura, Hidetoshi Nishimori
arxiv-2302-00998.description: Abstract The Ising model with a transverse field and an antiferromagnetic transverse interaction is represented as a matrix in the computational basis with non-zero off-diagonal elements with both positive and negative signs and thus may be regarded to be non-stoquastic.

arxiv-2307-14226.title: Explore the possibility of advancing climate negotiations on the basis of regional trade organizations: A study based on RICE-N
arxiv-2307-14226.creator: Wubo Dai
arxiv-2307-14226.description: Abstract Climate issues have become more and more important now. Although global governments have made some progress, we are still facing the truth that the prospect of international cooperation is not clear at present. Due to the limitations of the Integrated assessment models (IAMs) model, it is difficult to simulate the dynamic negotiation process.

arxiv-2403-15024.title: Riemannian Optimization and the Hartree–Fock Method
arxiv-2403-15024.creator: Caio Oliveira da Silva
arxiv-2403-15024.description: Abstract I dedicate this thesis to my grandmother ( in memoriam ), to my father and to Yuri. I was actually chasing a special sort of buzz, a special moment that comes sometimes. One teacher called these moments “mathematical experiences.” What I didn’t know then was that a mathematical experience was aesthetic in nature, an epiphany in Joyce’s original sense.

arxiv-2509-03433.title: Decoding Visual Neural Representations by Multimodal with Dynamic Balancing Journal: Expert Systems with Applications
arxiv-2509-03433.creator: Kaili Sun, Xingyu Miao #, Bing Zhai, Haoran Duan, Yang Long
arxiv-2509-03433.description: Abstract In this work, we propose an innovative framework that integrates EEG, image, and text data, aiming to decode visual neural representations from low signal-to-noise ratio EEG signals. Specifically, we introduce text modality to enhance the semantic correspondence between EEG signals and visual content.

arxiv-2601-20532.title: A Unified Symmetry Classification of Many-Body Localized Phases
arxiv-2601-20532.creator: Yucheng Wang
arxiv-2601-20532.description: Abstract Anderson localization admits a complete symmetry classification given by the Altland-Zirnbauer (AZ) tenfold scheme, whereas an analogous framework for interacting many-body localization (MBL) has remained elusive. Here we develop a symmetry-based classification of static MBL phases formulated at the level of local integrals of motion (LIOMs).

pmc-10744796.title: Evaluation of Seed Germination of Six Rare Stipa Species following Low Temperature Stress (Cryopreservation)
pmc-10744796.creator: Ekaterina Sergeevna Osipova, Dmitry Viktorovich Tereshonok, Evgeny Aleksandrovich Gladkov, Sergey Victorovich Evsyukov, Anna Yurievna Stepanova, Zhongjie Ding, Yanglin Ding
pmc-10744796.description: Cryopreservation is one way to preserve rare, endangered species. However, during the cryopreservation process, plant cells undergo considerable stress, which may lead to cell death. In our work, orthodox Stipa seeds of six rare species were cryopreserved: S. sareptana, S. ucrainica, S. tirsa, S. dasyphylla, S. adoxa, and S. pulcherríma.

pmc-11571113.title: Metal-Free CO Prodrugs Activated by Molecular Oxygen Protect against Doxorubicin-Induced Cardiomyopathy in Mice
pmc-11571113.creator: Xiaoxiao Yang, Wen Lu, Rodrigo W Alves de Souza, Qiyue Mao, Dipak Baram, Ravi Tripathi, Gangli Wang, Leo E Otterbein, Binghe Wang
pmc-11571113.description: Carbon monoxide has been extensively studied for its various therapeutic activities in cell cultures and animal models. Great efforts have been made to develop noninhalational approaches for easy and controlled CO delivery. Herein, we introduce a novel metal-free CO prodrug approach that releases CO under near-physiological conditions.

pmc-12659306.title: Mitigating cobalt toxicity in linseed (Linum usitatissimum L.): the role of ascorbic acid in enhancing pigments formation, antioxidant defense and gene expression
pmc-12659306.creator: Hamna Asif, Muhammad Bilawal Junaid, Habib Ali, Farwa Tariq, Muhammad Javed, Seema Batool, Imran Mahmood, Ghulam Abbas, Amal Mohamed AlGarawi, Komolitdin Sultonov, Jobborov Bakhrom, Aleksandra O Utkina, Mohd Asif Shah
pmc-12659306.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundElevated cobalt (Co) levels induce cellular toxicity and reduce overall plant growth and development. Ascorbic acid is known to enhance heavy metal tolerance in plants; however, its potential to reduce Co stress in linseed remains poorly understood.

pmc-13102823.title: Feasibility of embryonic-natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery for submucosal tumors with mucosal preservation in beagle model
pmc-13102823.creator: Han Lin, Chuan-Shen Jiang, Dong-Gui Hong, Long-Ping Chen, Yan Zhuang, Wen Lin, Zan-Xuan Qiu, Xin-Yi Zheng, Meng-Yao Xu, Li-Li Wu, Yang-Xin Xie, Wen Wang, Xiao-Jian He, Da-Zhou Li
pmc-13102823.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and aimsWhile endoscopic resection techniques such as endoscopic submucosal excavation (ESE) or endoscopic full-thickness resection (EFTR) enable the removal of gastrointestinal muscularis propria–originating submucosal tumors (MP-SMTs), these procedures still present certain limitations, including risks of perforation and hemorrhage. Therefore, we developed a novel embryonic-natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery (E-NOTES) approach designed to achieve complete resection of MP-SMTs while preserving mucosal integrity. This study evaluated its feasibility in beagle model.MethodsTwelve healthy beagles underwent E-NOTES using a gastric endoscope.

pmc-13141596.title: Delirium in German Nursing Homes – a qualitative study of care practice from the perspective of nurses and general practitioners
pmc-13141596.creator: Maike Kömp, Romy Lauer, Vincent Molitor, Theresa Sophie Busse, Chantal Flemm, Horst Christian Vollmar, Petra Thürmann, Bernhard Holle, Rebecca Palm, Ina Carola Otte
pmc-13141596.description: BackgroundDelirium is a multifactorial and potentially life-threatening syndrome that remains underdiagnosed and undertreated in nursing homes, despite residents’ high vulnerability due to advanced age, multimorbidity and cognitive impairment. To date, little is known how healthcare professionals perceive and manage delirium in these settings, particularly regarding prevention, diagnosis, therapy and interdisciplinary collaboration, as well as differentiation from other neurodegenerative diseases.

pmc-13185181.title: Guidelines on diagnosis and management of gastroesophageal reflux disease in infants, children and adolescents: a joint consensus from Italian pediatric societies (SIP and SIGENP) -part I. diagnosis
pmc-13185181.creator: Silvia Salvatore, Caterina Strisciuglio, Elena Bozzola, Stefania Cappa, Antonio Corsello, Giovanni Di Nardo, Maurizio Fuoti, Antonino Gulino, Chiara Mameli, Massimiliano Orso, Licia Pensabene, Barbara Polistena, Renato Tambucci, Francesca Vassallo, Claudio Romano, Annamaria Staiano
pmc-13185181.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundGastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) is a common reason for referral to pediatric and gastroenterology clinics. Still, uncertainty and variability exist in the evaluation, diagnostic approaches and management among different age groups and clinicians.

pmc-13554608.creator: Samantha Taylor, Natalie Finch, Sarah Caney, Jonathan Elliott, Rebecca Geddes, Femke Mortier, Valerie Parker, Jessica Quimby, Gilad Segev, Joanna White
pmc-13554608.description: Practical relevance:Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is common in senior cats. Early diagnosis can facilitate interventions to slow progression and minimise clinical signs.
